summary: Pulls a key matte from HSV ranges and outputs either a new alpha matte or the keyed source image.

key_params.name: huemin
key_params.note: Minimum hue included in the key

key_params.name: huemax
key_params.note: Maximum hue included in the key

key_params.name: satmin
key_params.note: Minimum saturation included in the key

key_params.name: satmax
key_params.note: Maximum saturation included in the key

key_params.name: valmin
key_params.note: Minimum value included in the key

key_params.name: valmax
key_params.note: Maximum value included in the key

common_gotchas: Hue, saturation, and value ranges all have to match before a pixel is included in the key.
Min/max ranges without soft controls often create harsh matte edges.
RGB Output and Alpha Output modes can make the node output a matte rather than keyed RGB.
Use the Palette chromaKey component when interactive sampling and spill controls are needed.
key_concepts: Chroma Key TOP selects pixels that fall inside Hue, Saturation, and Value min/max ranges.
Soft low and high controls feather the boundaries of Hue, Saturation, and Value ranges.
Output controls choose whether RGB is source multiplied by new alpha or the new alpha itself.
Alpha output can be the new alpha or source alpha multiplied by new alpha.
The Palette chromaKey component wraps this TOP with sampling, edge softening, and spill controls.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
